tables.name: co2_emissions
tables.comment: Yearly carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions per entity, total and by source. Units: million tonnes (Mt) unless stated.

columns.name: year
columns.comment: Calendar year.

columns.name: co2
columns.comment: Annual fossil and industry CO2 emissions, excluding land-use change, million tonnes (Mt). Default metric for "CO2 emissions".

columns.name: co2_per_capita
columns.comment: Annual CO2 emissions per person, tonnes per person (t/person).

columns.name: co2_per_gdp
columns.comment: Annual CO2 emissions per unit of GDP, kilograms per international-$ (kg/$).

columns.name: co2_per_unit_energy
columns.comment: Annual CO2 emissions per unit of primary energy, grams per kilowatt-hour (g/kWh).

columns.name: co2_growth_abs
columns.comment: Absolute change in annual CO2 emissions from the previous year, million tonnes (Mt).

columns.name: co2_growth_prct
columns.comment: Percentage change in annual CO2 emissions from the previous year, percent (%).

columns.name: coal_co2
columns.comment: Annual CO2 emissions from coal, million tonnes (Mt).

columns.name: oil_co2
columns.comment: Annual CO2 emissions from oil, million tonnes (Mt).

columns.name: gas_co2
columns.comment: Annual CO2 emissions from natural gas, million tonnes (Mt).

columns.name: cement_co2
columns.comment: Annual CO2 emissions from cement production, million tonnes (Mt).

columns.name: flaring_co2
columns.comment: Annual CO2 emissions from gas flaring, million tonnes (Mt).

columns.name: other_industry_co2
columns.comment: Annual CO2 emissions from other industry sources, million tonnes (Mt).

columns.name: coal_co2_per_capita
columns.comment: Annual CO2 emissions from coal per person, tonnes per person (t/person).

columns.name: oil_co2_per_capita
columns.comment: Annual CO2 emissions from oil per person, tonnes per person (t/person).

columns.name: gas_co2_per_capita
columns.comment: Annual CO2 emissions from gas per person, tonnes per person (t/person).

columns.name: land_use_change_co2
columns.comment: Annual CO2 emissions from land-use change (e.g. deforestation), million tonnes (Mt). Can be negative (net removal).

columns.name: co2_including_luc
columns.comment: Annual CO2 emissions including land-use change, million tonnes (Mt).

columns.name: co2_including_luc_per_capita
columns.comment: Annual CO2 emissions including land-use change per person, tonnes per person (t/person).

columns.name: consumption_co2
columns.comment: Annual consumption-based (trade-adjusted) CO2 emissions, million tonnes (Mt).

columns.name: consumption_co2_per_capita
columns.comment: Annual consumption-based CO2 emissions per person, tonnes per person (t/person).

columns.name: trade_co2
columns.comment: CO2 emissions embedded in trade (consumption minus production), million tonnes (Mt). Positive = net importer of CO2.

columns.name: trade_co2_share
columns.comment: CO2 embedded in trade as a percentage of production-based emissions, percent (%).

columns.name: cumulative_co2
columns.comment: Cumulative CO2 emissions since the first recorded year, million tonnes (Mt).

columns.name: share_global_co2
columns.comment: Share of global annual CO2 emissions, percent (%).

columns.name: share_global_cumulative_co2
columns.comment: Share of global cumulative CO2 emissions, percent (%).

tables.name: countries
tables.comment: Countries and aggregate entities (World, continents, EU, income groups). Filter entity_type = 'country' when ranking or comparing countries.

columns.name: name
columns.comment: Entity name as published by Our World in Data, e.g. India, United States, World, Europe.

columns.name: iso_code
columns.comment: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code, e.g. IND, USA. NULL for aggregates and Kosovo.

columns.name: entity_type
columns.comment: country | region (World, continents, EU, OECD) | income_group (World Bank income groups) | other (international aviation/shipping, Kuwaiti oil fires, Ryukyu Islands).

tables.name: country_indicators
tables.comment: Yearly population, GDP and primary energy use per entity.

columns.name: year
columns.comment: Calendar year.

columns.name: population
columns.comment: Population (people).

columns.name: gdp
columns.comment: Gross domestic product, international-$ at 2011 prices (Maddison Project). Available up to 2022 only.

columns.name: primary_energy_consumption
columns.comment: Primary energy consumption, terawatt-hours (TWh).

columns.name: energy_per_capita
columns.comment: Primary energy consumption per person, kilowatt-hours per person (kWh/person).

columns.name: energy_per_gdp
columns.comment: Primary energy consumption per unit of GDP, kilowatt-hours per international-$ (kWh/$).

tables.name: ghg_emissions
tables.comment: Yearly greenhouse gas emissions (methane, nitrous oxide, total GHG) and contribution to global warming per entity.

columns.name: year
columns.comment: Calendar year.

columns.name: methane
columns.comment: Annual methane (CH4) emissions, million tonnes of CO2-equivalents (MtCO2e).

columns.name: methane_per_capita
columns.comment: Annual methane emissions per person, tonnes of CO2-equivalents per person.

columns.name: nitrous_oxide
columns.comment: Annual nitrous oxide (N2O) emissions, million tonnes of CO2-equivalents (MtCO2e).

columns.name: nitrous_oxide_per_capita
columns.comment: Annual nitrous oxide emissions per person, tonnes of CO2-equivalents per person.

columns.name: total_ghg
columns.comment: Total greenhouse gas emissions including land-use change and forestry, million tonnes of CO2-equivalents (MtCO2e). Can be negative.

columns.name: total_ghg_excluding_lucf
columns.comment: Total greenhouse gas emissions excluding land-use change and forestry, million tonnes of CO2-equivalents (MtCO2e).

columns.name: ghg_per_capita
columns.comment: Total greenhouse gas emissions including land use per person, tonnes of CO2-equivalents per person.

columns.name: ghg_excluding_lucf_per_capita
columns.comment: Total greenhouse gas emissions excluding land use per person, tonnes of CO2-equivalents per person.

columns.name: temperature_change_from_ghg
columns.comment: Contribution to global mean surface temperature change from all greenhouse gases, degrees Celsius (°C).

columns.name: temperature_change_from_co2
columns.comment: Contribution to global temperature change from CO2, degrees Celsius (°C).

columns.name: temperature_change_from_ch4
columns.comment: Contribution to global temperature change from methane, degrees Celsius (°C).

columns.name: temperature_change_from_n2o
columns.comment: Contribution to global temperature change from nitrous oxide, degrees Celsius (°C).

columns.name: share_of_temperature_change_from_ghg
columns.comment: Share of global temperature change from greenhouse gases, percent (%).
